VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_STAR_CHART.title: Solitary Crown
VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_STAR_CHART.descript: Whenever any enemy dies, immediately heal [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your Max HP, rounded up. The same death event from the same entity triggers only once; different enemies trigger separately. Triggers and total healing are uncapped.
VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_STAR_CHART.flavor: She stands apart beneath the crown; every fall sustains that solitary height.
